The biggest gap is section header format inconsistency: the first 2 modules (scrapydocs, qps-bench-server) correctly used '#### 功能概述 (Purpose)' (h4 + English), but the remaining 5 modules switched to '### 功能概述' (h3, Chinese only), which the automated verifier does not detect as compliant. This caused Appendix G to report 171 missing sections across 6 modules (only 9% complete blocks), triggering failures in R5, P3, S2, S3, S5. The root cause is agent context drift in long multi-module sessions — the template was followed correctly early but not re-consulted later. The Skill's post-write validation step (phase3-detail.md Step 4) exists but is advisory rather than blocking. Secondary failures: YAML frontmatter missing from 5/7 DETAIL files (R7) and malformed infrastructure closing markers. Fix priority: (1) enforce #### header format in phase3-detail.md with a hard blocking assertion on section counts, (2) add prominent copy-paste header block at top of sub-agent prompt template to prevent drift, (3) regenerate or reformat the 5 non-conforming DETAIL files.
